---
title: element-blank
subtitle: "Blank element: hides the corresponding theme element."
category: Themes
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Pass the result to [`theme`](theme.qmd) under keys like `panel-grid` or `axis-line`
to turn them off entirely.

## Usage

```typst
element-blank()
```



## Returns

Element dictionary consumed by [`theme`](theme.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/element-blank-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (x: i, y: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  theme: theme(panel-grid: element-blank()),
)
```

## See also

[`theme`](theme.qmd), [`element-text`](element-text.qmd), [`element-line`](element-line.qmd), [`element-rect`](element-rect.qmd).
